title: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 2: Huduma ya kwanza)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child orders words by first, second and third letter, finds the root of a verb, and reads the meaning that fits the passage.
representations: a verb with its parts coloured

board.do: Point at the second letters of "dawa" and "damu".
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child orders the words and finds "bandeji" in the dictionary.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?" Kwa nini "mti" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kamusi hupanga maneno kwa herufi za alfabeti, si kwa urefu wa neno.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno gani huja kwanza kwenye kamusi?" Kwa nini "samaki" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Maneno yanapoanza kwa herufi moja, tazama herufi ya pili, kisha ya tatu: sahani huja kabla ya samaki.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Neno gani huja mwisho kwenye kamusi?" Kwa nini "ndizi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Alfabeti huanza na A na kuishia na Z. Neno la mwisho kwenye kamusi huanza na herufi ya mwisho zaidi.

misconceptions.ask: Mzizi wa kitenzi hiki ni upi?
misconceptions.repair: Kamusi huorodhesha mzizi wa kitenzi: tafuta "soma".
